sentences.en: In winter I tuck myself up in a duvet.
sentences.zh: 1. 冬天我会把自己裹进被窝里。

sentences.en: At night, parents tuck their children into bed.
sentences.zh: 2. 晚上，父母会把孩子塞到床上。

sentences.en: I tuck my children into bed every night.
sentences.zh: 3. 我每天晚上都会把孩子们塞到床上。
